name: Manaslu Circuit Trek
summary: A loop around the Manaslu massif up the Budhi Gandaki from Soti Khola or Machha Khola, over the Larkya La and down the Marsyangdi to join the Annapurna Circuit road at Dharapani. It is a restricted area, so a licensed guide and a permit obtained through an agency are required.

name: Tsum Valley Trek
summary: A side valley off the Manaslu approach, branching north at Lokpa into a Tibetan-Buddhist enclave of gompas and villages, with Mu Gompa at the head of the valley the usual turnaround. Most walkers combine it with the Manaslu Circuit; on its own it is an out-and-back and stays comparatively low.

name: Upper Mustang Trek
summary: A walk north from Jomsom up the Kali Gandaki through the arid former kingdom of Lo to the walled town of Lo Manthang, returning by the eastern villages of Yara and Tangge. It sits in the rain shadow of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges, so it stays walkable through the monsoon, and it is a restricted area needing a permit and a guide.

name: Upper Dolpo Trek
summary: A long camping traverse of the Tibetan-culture districts north of Phoksundo Lake, usually from Juphal over the Kang La to Shey Gompa and Saldang and out to Jomsom or back to Juphal. Several route variants exist and all cross a series of passes above 5,000 m with no lodges and no resupply.

name: Lower Dolpo Trek
summary: A camping circuit from the Juphal airstrip to Phoksundo Lake, over the Baga La and Numa La into the Tarap valley and back down the Thulo Bheri. It stays south of the Upper Dolpo restricted zone but still crosses two passes above 5,000 m.

name: Kanchenjunga Base Camp Trek
summary: A long approach in far eastern Nepal from Taplejung through Limbu and Sherpa villages to the north base camp at Pangpema below Kangchenjunga's north face, often extended over the Sele La to the south side at Oktang. It is a restricted area with sparse lodges and several days far from any road.

name: Makalu Base Camp Trek
summary: An out-and-back from Tumlingtar and Num up the Arun and Barun valleys, over the Shipton La and Keke La, to the base camp on the Barun Glacier under Makalu's west face. Lodges are basic and intermittent, and parties often camp on the upper section.

name: Dhaulagiri Circuit Trek
summary: A camping route around the Dhaulagiri massif from Beni up the Myagdi Khola to Dhaulagiri Base Camp, over the French Pass into Hidden Valley and out over the Dhampus Pass to Marpha. There are no lodges above Italian Base Camp, glacier moraine to cross and two consecutive days above 5,000 m.

name: Nar Phu + Annapurna Circuit
summary: The restricted Nar and Phu valleys, entered from Koto on the Annapurna Circuit, then the Kang La back to Ngawal to rejoin the main circuit through Manang and over the Thorong La to Muktinath. Two passes above 5,000 m, the second of them the Thorong La.

name: Ruby Valley Trek
summary: A low-altitude route between the Ganesh Himal and Manaslu foothills north of Dhading, crossing the Pangsang La between Tamang and Gurung villages. It needs no restricted-area permit and stays well below 4,000 m throughout.

name: Rara Lake Trek
summary: A loop from the Jumla airstrip in Karnali over the Ghurchi Lagna to Rara Lake, Nepal's largest, at 2,990 m in Rara National Park, returning across the Danphe Lagna. Facilities are limited and most parties camp or use homestays.
